claims: The Artemis II crew successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego on April 10, 2026.
Artemis II marks the return of the first crewed lunar voyage in over 50 years.
Re-entry video shows the Artemis II capsule descending under parachutes.
The Artemis II splashdown was a "perfect bullseye" landing.
The Artemis II splashdown occurred at 8:07 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II splashdown occurred in the Pacific Ocean near San Diego, California.
Artemis II was the first crewed flight to the Moon since 1972.
